body: ShankpitAuthHandler: GET /shankpit → redirect to Google consent (CSRF state cookie). /callback: exchange code → userinfo → upsertPlayer (S43-02 pattern) → IDUNA JWT (sub=player_id, display_name, aud=shankpit, 72h TTL) → redirect to shankpit://auth?token=JWT&player_id=UUID&display_name=NAME. GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET + SHANKPIT_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI env vars. All tests pass.
title: S43-03: SHANKPIT Google OAuth browser flow — /api/v1/auth/google/shankpit + /callback
